title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon
description:
A simplistic dungeon crawling experience with complex ATB battles akin to 90s JRPGs, your success in Ark's Wonder Dungeon's relies on risky resource management in the overworld and assessing equipment in order to assemble a team able to take on any battle headfirst!

With over 200+ combat items to claim and an ever-growing catalogue of events between battles, your greatest strength will be mastery of what's been given. 

Ark's Wonder Dungeon has chatty characters who always have something to say about their situation... or one another.

The narrative surrounding the dungeon and the characters shifts as more progress is made through its ringmaster's halls! The dungeoneers' freedom nears with every further run. There are 35+ unique campfire stories that may randomly play out and every story cutscene has accompanying illustrations!

Though the 6 playable characters can shred through small enemies given one utilizes their unique arsenals intelligently, only the most strategic players may overcome the dangerous enraged beasts roaming off the beaten path.

Do you have what it takes to escape?

No, no... the better question is: do they deserve to?
description_short: Explore looping halls, chat around the campfire with dungeoneering misfits, and learn to make the most of each turn in this JRPG dungeon crawler!
